hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
REGION="us-east-1" SECRET_ID='rds!db-8086eb77-cd6d-48bc-9298-4380892798ca'
DB_HOST='dictionarydb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com' DB_PORT="5432" DB_USER="postgres" DB_NAME="dictionary_db"
ROLE_ARN="arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="s3-test" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="1800"
S3_BUCKET="avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl" S3_PREFIX="general/hpds/javabin"
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Missing $1" >&2; exit 2; }; } need aws need jq need docker need tar
WORKDIR="${WORKSPACE:-$PWD}" ts="$(date '+%m-%d-%yT%H')" TAR_NAME="${WORKDIR}/dictionary_db_${ts}.tar" S3_URI="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${S3_PREFIX}/$(basename "$TAR_NAME")"
rm -f "$TAR_NAME"
# pull password once (host-side) conn_pass="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \ --secret-id "$SECRET_ID" \ --region "$REGION" \ --query SecretString \ --output text | jq -r .password)"
# Run pg_dump inside postgres:16, but stream tar to host file. # IMPORTANT: keep tar bytes on STDOUT only; all logs go to STDERR. docker run --rm \ -e PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" \ postgres:16-bookworm \ bash -lc " set -euo pipefail
echo 'Testing connection...' >&2 psql --host='$DB_HOST' --port='$DB_PORT' --username='$DB_USER' --dbname='$DB_NAME' -c '\\q' >&2 echo 'Connection test successful!' >&2
rm -rf /tmp/dictionary_db.sql pg_dump \ --host='$DB_HOST' \ --port='$DB_PORT' \ --username='$DB_USER' \ --format=d \ --file=/tmp/dictionary_db.sql \ --jobs=10 \ --verbose \ --no-owner --no-privileges --no-tablespaces --no-unlogged-table-data --no-comments \ --no-publications --no-subscriptions --no-security-labels --no-toast-compression --no-table-access-method \ --schema=dict \ '$DB_NAME' >&2
# stream tar to STDOUT tar -C /tmp -cf - dictionary_db.sql " > "$TAR_NAME"
# sanity checks (host-side) test -s "$TAR_NAME" tar -tf "$TAR_NAME" | head -n 20 >&2
# Assume role + upload assume_json="$(mktemp)" aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
aws s3 cp "$TAR_NAME" "$S3_URI" --no-progress
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN echo "$S3_URI" > "${WORKDIR}/db_dump_name.txt"
echo "Uploaded: $S3_URI" >&2
